title: FRE 608(a) — bolstering gated by 'after attack'
signal: A party offers reputation or opinion evidence on a witness's character for truthfulness, but no prior attack on that character appears in the record.
student_move: Apply the trigger check: has the witness's character for truthfulness been attacked (e.g., by prior inconsistent statement, bias, conviction of crime, reputation, or contradiction)? If not, the bolstering opinion is not admissible under 608(a).
tiny_rule: FRE 608(a) authorizes opinion/reputation evidence on truthfulness only after an attack; mere testimony is not an attack.
trap: The dominant trap is to assume bolstering is always permitted when the witness has taken the stand. It is not — the trigger must be met first.

title: Do not collapse the two spousal privileges
signal: Divorced spouse asked about a private statement from the marriage.
student_move: Separate testimonial privilege from communications privilege before choosing sustain or overrule.
tiny_rule: Current marriage matters for testimonial privilege; private communication during marriage matters for communications privilege.

title: Transcript = two layers
signal: A transcript carries a statement from an earlier proceeding.
student_move: Ask: what admits the speaker's statement, and what admits the transcript?
trap: Picking the first familiar exception name.

title: Purpose beats suspicious topic
signal: Client asks whether a proposed act would be fraudulent.
student_move: Ask whether the client is seeking compliance advice or help carrying out wrongdoing.
tiny_rule: Crime-fraud needs furtherance; compliance advice remains privileged.

title: Relevance is a clue threshold
signal: Opponent says the evidence has innocent explanations or is not conclusive.
student_move: Ask what fact the evidence tends to make more likely.
tiny_rule: A clue need not be a confession.

title: Religion Evidence: Purpose Split
signal: Religious affiliation appears, but the proponent says bias.
student_move: Do not stop at the religious-evidence objection. Ask the offered purpose.
tiny_rule: Belief-as-truthfulness is barred; affiliation-for-bias is not.

title: Gate Before Weight
signal: Unidentified object; no witness; no marking; no chain/source fact.
student_move: Cut weight arguments until a threshold link exists.
tiny_rule: A jury weighs weak evidence; it does not supply the first connection.

title: Rule 407 Purpose Lock
signal: Post-injury fix plus answer choices about relevance, feasibility, or negligence-only scope.
student_move: Name the offered purpose before reading exceptions.
tiny_rule: Defect/warning purpose is barred; feasibility is not automatic.
trap: Treating feasibility or relevance as a universal admission route.

title: Real object needs a bridge
signal: Physical object offered, but no fact connects it to the charged event or issue.
student_move: Ask: what fact does this object make more likely?
tiny_rule: Object category is not a bridge.
trap: The crime label makes the object feel relevant.
